settings.heading: A house named for a griddle
settings.text: Maison is house. Tavo takes its name from the flat griddle of Marwar. In a gharana, a way of doing things passes from teacher to pupil. In a kitchen it can be as small as a hand showing you when to turn the bread.

settings.heading: A shape for the work
settings.text: A low lip for the dosa. Deep sides for the stock. Forge draws those shapes in clad steel. Jaipur’s hammered bronze informs the material work. Chulha goes back to the potter’s wheel, with a pot for chai and a wide handi for biryani. Its finishes, capacities and hob fit are still design targets.

settings.heading: About Maison Tavo
settings.lede: Kartavya Jharwal moved house. The old pan came out of the box. Would it work on the new hob? A small question, usually asked with the onions already cut.

settings.text:
On Dhanteras, a new metal vessel comes home. It shines on the shelf. The old tawa is already on the fire.

Your grandmother watches the edge of the roti. You watch her hand. Years later, in a kitchen she never saw, you wait for the same little lift.
